style: Single game character sprite of ONE Thai temple visitor, semi-realistic soft painted 3D-render look (like a high quality stylized mobile game), natural human proportions, adult body, warm soft daylight from the upper left, gentle shading. The camera is BEHIND the person and slightly above, looking forward at their back as they face away toward an altar that is NOT shown. Seen strictly from behind: only the back of the head and the back of the body are visible, no face, no eyes, no glasses, no front of the body. Whole body fully inside the frame with margin on every side, centered, feet and legs included. Background: ONE flat solid pure chroma green color #00FF00 everywhere, no gradient, no floor, no shadow on the background, no altar, no statue, no props, no text, no frame. Clothing and skin must not contain any green color.

shots.prompt: Elderly Thai woman with grey hair in a neat low bun, white long-sleeve blouse and long white wrap skirt (traditional white temple clothes). She kneels sitting back on her heels, back straight, both hands pressed together in a wai at her chest (hands hidden in front of her body, only her elbows show at the sides). Soles of her bare feet visible under her bottom.

Elderly Thai woman with grey hair in a neat low bun, white long-sleeve blouse and long white wrap skirt (traditional white temple clothes). She is doing a full Thai prostration: kneeling, bent fully forward, forehead and both forearms resting flat on the floor in front of her, bottom on her heels. Seen from behind so we see her rounded back, the back of her head low near the floor, and the soles of her bare feet.
